subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with regard to forests?

options.text: They sustain huge diversity of flora and fauna

solution:
The correct answer is__** They do not conserve soil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forests** play a crucial role in maintaining the **ecological balance** and providing various benefits to humans as well as other living beings.
 
• **Soil conservation:**
 
 
• Forests protect the soil from **erosion** caused by **wind and water.**
 
• The roots of trees hold the soil together and prevent it from getting **washed away** during heavy rains or floods.
 
• Forests also help in **maintaining soil fertility **by adding organic matter to it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the key points explaining the** importance of forests **are as follows:
 
• **Water conservation:**
 
 
• Forests act as **natural water reservoirs **and help in regulating the **water cycle.**
 
• They absorb **rainfall, prevent soil erosion, and recharge groundwater.**
 
• This, in turn, helps in **maintaining the water level **in rivers, lakes, and other water bodies.
 
 
 
• **Variety of products:**
 
 
• Forests provide a wide range of products such as** timber, fruits, nuts, medicinal plants,** and other **non-timber forest products.**
 
• These products are used for various purposes such as **construction, furniture making, food, and medicine.**
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity conservation:**
 
 
• Forests are home to a diverse range of **flora and fauna.**
 
• They provide a habitat for numerous species of **animals, birds, insects, and microorganisms.**
 
• Forests also help in maintaining the **genetic diversity **of plant species.
